In addition to capital and an idea, we provide founders with access to investor networks, fundraising support, and the resources needed to build transformational companies. Our AI Studio has launched 17 companies since 2023, and we're launching 7 more in 2026. We're designed to help Founders move faster, develop better insights, and build companies that have a higher success rate than startups built in any other way. What We're Looking At: The US needs 300,000 new electricians over the next decade. Electrical work alone accounts for up to 70% of data center construction costs. The bottleneck isn't capital or land. It's qualified technicians. Forum AI Studio https://www.forumvc.com/ai-studio is looking for Founders that have deep domain knowledge in mechanical, electrical and plumbing projects, skilled trades, and/or workforce development. Maybe you've run MEP projects and know the commissioning floor firsthand. Maybe you've built workforce or training platforms and understand how skilled trades pipelines actually work. Maybe you've sold software into contractors and know what they'll actually pay for. Whichever background matches the path above, we want to hear from you. You don't need to have done all four, you need to know exactly where this industry is broken and be relentless about fixing it. jobgether-jobgether:lever:284e35a2-e5b9-.title: Associate Admissions Advisor
jobgether-jobgether:lever:284e35a2-e5b9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Admissions Advisor based in Canada. This is a fully remote opportunity for a people-focused professional who enjoys building relationships and helping others take meaningful next steps. You’ll be one of the first points of contact for prospective students exploring education and career opportunities. Through high-volume outbound conversations, you’ll learn about their goals, motivations, and interests while helping them determine the right path forward. You’ll develop strong communication, consultative selling, and relationship-building skills while working toward clear performance goals. The role offers structured coaching, ongoing development, and a clear pathway toward an Admissions Advisor position. You’ll join a collaborative admissions environment focused on creating positive experiences and supporting student success. Conduct high-volume outbound calls to prospective students who have expressed interest in available education programs. Build rapport quickly, create a positive first impression, and engage prospective students in meaningful conversations about their educational and career goals. Ask thoughtful questions and actively listen to understand each prospective student's motivations, needs, concerns, and readiness to pursue further education. Answer initial questions and help prospective students assess whether their program interests align with their personal and professional objectives. Pre-qualify prospective students and connect engaged, qualified candidates with an Admissions Advisor through scheduled appointments or live transfers. Maintain a consistent outreach schedule and work toward individual and team conversion, productivity, and engagement KPIs. Accurately document conversations, prospect information, follow-ups, and activities using relevant systems and processes. Manage follow-ups effectively to maintain a healthy admissions pipeline and ensure prospective students continue progressing through the appropriate next steps. Collaborate with Admissions Advisors and other team members to support recruitment initiatives, share insights, and contribute to student-focused team goals. Take ownership of personal performance, actively participate in coaching, and continuously improve communication and relationship-building techniques. Requirements: Previous experience in customer service, sales, retail, call centre operations, admissions, recruitment, or another people-focused environment. Strong verbal communication skills and the ability to build rapport and establish trust quickly over the phone. Customer-focused mindset with the ability to listen actively, ask relevant questions, understand needs, and guide conversations toward an appropriate next step. Comfort working toward measurable goals, KPIs, and performance targets in a high-volume outreach environment. Resilience and positive energy when handling a high volume of conversations, including situations where prospects are not ready to proceed. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage follow-ups and maintain accurate records. Ability to work independently and remain productive, accountable, and focused in a fully remote environment. Openness to coaching and feedback, with a genuine interest in developing sales, communication, and relationship-management skills. Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow established processes while adapting communication to different prospective students. A growth mindset and motivation to progress toward an Admissions Advisor role. Benefits: CAD $45,000 annual base salary plus competitive commission. Fully remote work arrangement for candidates based in Ontario . Regular working schedule of 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET , Monday to Friday, with a bi-weekly Saturday shift. Clear career-development pathway toward an Admissions Advisor posit

jobgether-jobgether:lever:6a54eeb2-0445-.title: Romanian Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobgether-jobgether:lever:6a54eeb2-0445-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Romanian Voice Actor – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Israel. This freelance opportunity is designed for an experienced Romanian voice professional interested in helping shape the next generation of AI-powered speech technology. You will contribute authentic, high-quality Romanian voice data used to improve the clarity, naturalness, and expressiveness of AI-generated speech. The work combines professional voice performance with speech evaluation, linguistic feedback, and AI training activities. You will record scripted content while assessing AI outputs for pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional accuracy. Your expertise will help refine voice models and evaluation standards for applications spanning accessibility, education, entertainment, and more. The project offers a flexible remote environment suited to experienced contractors with a professional recording setup. It is an opportunity to apply your voice expertise to emerging AI technologies while directly influencing how machines communicate in Romanian. Record scripted material in Romanian with clear pronunciation, natural delivery, consistent pacing, and appropriate emotional expression. Produce high-quality voice recordings suitable for AI training and speech-model development. Evaluate AI-generated speech for linguistic accuracy, pronunciation, naturalness, tone, pacing, and expressiveness. Identify and annotate errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated outputs and provide clear, actionable feedback. Assess regional and linguistic variations in Romanian to help improve the authenticity and robustness of voice models. Collaborate with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, annotation practices, and voice-design guidelines. Apply professional voice-acting expertise to distinguish natural human speech from awkward, inaccurate, or unnatural AI-generated responses. Maintain consistent recording quality and follow technical, linguistic, and project-specific guidelines throughout assignments. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in Romanian voice acting, dubbing, narration, or a closely related performance discipline. Native-level or highly proficient Romanian language skills with excellent pronunciation and linguistic accuracy. Strong vocal control, including the ability to adjust tone, pacing, emphasis, emotion, and delivery according to different scripts and contexts. Excellent listening and evaluation skills, with the ability to identify subtle pronunciation, fluency, and naturalness issues. Strong attention to detail and the ability to provide precise, constructive feedback. Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to follow detailed project guidelines. Experience with linguistic annotation, voice coaching, AI training, speech evaluation, or similar work is a plus. Access to a reliable computer, stable internet connection, high-quality microphone, and quiet recording environment. Ability to work independently and consistently as a remote freelance contractor. Curiosity about AI and an interest in contributing professional expertise to emerging speech technologies. Benefits Freelance contract with fully remote work. Flexible project-based working environment. Opportunity to contribute directly to the development and improvement of AI speech technology. Pay ranging from US$6 to US$65 per hour , with the final rate determined by experience, expertise, and geographic location. Opportunity to apply professional Romanian voice expertise to large-scale AI training projects. Exposure to cutting-edge AI tools, speech technologies, and evaluation methodologies. Contractor flexibility, with the understanding that equipment, internet, health insurance, PTO, and other employee-sponsored benefits are not provided. Contractors are responsible for supplying their own secure

Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Technical Architect Lead based in India. This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role focused on transforming advanced AI and machine learning capabilities into secure, scalable, production-ready solutions. You will shape AI/ML strategy and architecture while directly contributing to model development, deployment, integration, and operationalization. Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint). We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance. Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below. Communication: - Good level of spoken and written English, Spanish - Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and marketing. southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:39.title: Workplace & Engagement Coordinator
southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:39.description: WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS. We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring a Workplace & Engagement Coordinator to support our Singapore office and help create a warm, welcoming, and well-run workplace experience. This is a hands-on, people-facing role that blends logistics and operations with hospitality and judgment. No day will look the same, and you’ll wear multiple hats to help keep the office running smoothly as our Singapore team grows! WHAT YOU’LL DO Be the face of the office - Greet employees, candidates, and guests with professionalism and warmth - Coordinate with building security to ensure a smooth, secure arrival experience - Support recruiting by welcoming candidates and helping interviews run on time Keep the office moving - Manage incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and deliveries throughout the day - Coordinate and communicate out the ordering of employee meals (lunch, dinner) as needed - Assist office services teams (custodial, culinary, vendors) as needed - Help troubleshoot day-to-day issues and escalate when appropriate Support workplace operations & events - Partner closely with the Employee Experience team on daily needs and employee onboarding processes - Stock and coordinate distribution of office supplies and swag for employees and guests - Coordinate client meetings, interviews, and team offsites for employees across our team - Assist in planning office events and activities to keep morale high Contribute to a great employee experience - Notice what’s working and what isn’t in the office environment - Pitch in during busy moments, events, and high-traffic days - Help create a calm, welcoming, and reliable experience for everyone in the space (and eventually know all employees by first name!) WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Professional, friendly presence with strong communication skills - Comfortable in a highly visible, customer-facing role - Organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through - Able to balance structure with flexibility in a fast-moving environment - Comfortable lifting up to 35 lbs and being on your feet throughout the day - Experience in front desk, office coordination, hospitality, or rapid-growth companies is a plus - Creativity and interest in employee events is also a plus WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Our office is more than a grouping of desks - it’s a central hub for our Singapore team. This role helps shape how employees feel about coming into the office, how candidates experience us during interviews, and how smoothly the workplace functions day to day. You’ll have real ownership, real visibility, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how the office feels and runs. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any.

titanwh-titanwh:lever:d1aa6e70-7938-4a33.title: Senior Paraplanner
titanwh-titanwh:lever:d1aa6e70-7938-4a33.description: The Titan Group provides a broad range of services across the whole wealth value chain – from financial planning, investment management through to platform, trading, settlement and custody services. Its strategy is to be able to offer modular, incremental services to its clients allowing them to adjust their business models as and when they choose to. As part of this Titan is also an active acquirer of UK based asset managers and other wealth related businesses. Due to this Titan Wealth is expanding rapidly through strategic acquisitions, offering a unique combination of start-up energy and the security of private equity backing. It’s an inspiring time to join the team! Titan Wealth Planning (TWP) is a subsidiary of Titan Wealth. Our focus is providing best-in-class advice on wealth management, employee benefits, and retirement planning. Our mission is to help businesses and their employees explore, set, and achieve their financial goals. About the role Our team in Edinburgh is growing! Are you a level 4 qualified Paraplanner looking for the opportunity of a new challenge? You’ll play a key role in delivering an outstanding client experience by providing high‑quality technical and report‑writing support to our advisers. Working closely with our Paraplanning team, you’ll produce clear, tailored suitability reports that reflect individual client needs, while also helping to keep our report templates and models accurate, current and fit for purpose. This role is a great opportunity for someone that enjoys working technical cases and offering support to our associate paraplanners. Full-time, permanent. Edinburgh office with flexible hybrid working pattern.
